verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report confirms that a Snowflake trial exists. The user loaded data and ran real workloads during it, consuming about 9 credits and 40GB of storage (roughly $19.60). There is no first-party documentation of the trial's terms, and nothing in the evidence addresses whether a credit card or sales contact is required. The pricing page's 'Standard' entry-level tier is a paid edition, not a free tier. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the free trial and its credit allowance, evidence that no credit card is required, evidence that no sales call is required, any always-free tier.
